attributes.title: [Logs OpenFSSO] Receivers
attributes.description: Mappings, rejected requests and collector availability of the OpenFSSO receivers.

query.esql:
FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE (event.category == "session" AND event.outcome == "success") OR event.action == "receiver-ready"
| INLINE STATS started = MAX(CASE(event.action == "receiver-ready", @timestamp, NULL)) BY host.name, service.node.name
| WHERE event.category == "session" AND (started IS NULL OR @timestamp > started)
| STATS latest = MAX(CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", event.action)) BY host.name, service.node.name, user.name, source.ip
| WHERE NOT ENDS_WITH(latest, " logout")
| STATS mapped = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name)

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE (event.category == "session" AND event.outcome == "success") OR event.action == "receiver-ready"
| INLINE STATS started = MAX(CASE(event.action == "receiver-ready", @timestamp, NULL)) BY host.name, service.node.name
| WHERE event.category == "session" AND (started IS NULL OR @timestamp > started)
| STATS latest = MAX(CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", event.action)) BY host.name, service.node.name, user.name, source.ip
| WHERE NOT ENDS_WITH(latest, " logout")
| STATS mapped = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name)

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("ip-claim-rejected", "identity-rejected", "account-revoked") OR (openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| STATS rejected = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("ip-claim-rejected", "identity-rejected", "account-revoked") OR (openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| STATS rejected = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.category == "session" AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failures = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.category == "session" AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failures = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action == "collector-availability-changed" AND openfsso.collector_available == false
| STATS outages = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action == "collector-availability-changed" AND openfsso.collector_available == false
| STATS outages = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.category == "session"
| EVAL event = CASE(event.outcome == "failure", CONCAT(event.action, " failed"), event.action)
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.category == "session"
| EVAL event = CASE(event.outcome == "failure", CONCAT(event.action, " failed"), event.action)
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), event
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action == "logout"
| STATS logouts = COUNT(*) BY event.reason
| SORT logouts DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action == "logout"
| STATS logouts = COUNT(*) BY event.reason
| SORT logouts DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("ip-claim-rejected", "identity-rejected", "account-revoked", "account-check-failed") OR (openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| EVAL rejection = CASE(openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey", "health-key-failed", event.action)
| STATS rejections = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), rejection
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("ip-claim-rejected", "identity-rejected", "account-revoked", "account-check-failed") OR (openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| EVAL rejection = CASE(openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey", "health-key-failed", event.action)
| STATS rejections = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), rejection
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("ip-claim-rejected", "identity-rejected", "account-revoked") OR (openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| EVAL rejection = CASE(openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey", "health-key-failed", event.action)
| STATS rejections = COUNT(*), latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY source.ip, rejection
| SORT rejections DESC
| LIMIT 50

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("ip-claim-rejected", "identity-rejected", "account-revoked") OR (openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| EVAL rejection = CASE(openfsso.authentication_scheme == "HealthKey", "health-key-failed", event.action)
| STATS rejections = COUNT(*), latest = MAX(@timestamp) BY source.ip, rejection
| SORT rejections DESC
| LIMIT 50

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE service.node.name IS NOT NULL
| EVAL collector = CASE(event.action == "collector-availability-changed", CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), CASE(openfsso.collector_available, " running", " stopped")), NULL)
| STATS last_start = MAX(CASE(event.action == "receiver-ready", @timestamp, NULL)), version = MAX(CASE(service.version IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", service.version), NULL)), collector = MAX(collector), mapping_events = COUNT(CASE(event.category == "session" AND event.outcome == "success", 1, NULL)), syslog_failures = COUNT(CASE(event.category == "session" AND event.outcome == "failure", 1, NULL)), warnings = COUNT(CASE(log.level IN ("Warning", "Error", "Fatal"), 1, NULL)) BY host.name, service.node.name
| EVAL collector = MV_LAST(SPLIT(collector, " ")), version = MV_LAST(SPLIT(version, " "))
| SORT host.name, service.node.name

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE service.node.name IS NOT NULL
| EVAL collector = CASE(event.action == "collector-availability-changed", CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), CASE(openfsso.collector_available, " running", " stopped")), NULL)
| STATS last_start = MAX(CASE(event.action == "receiver-ready", @timestamp, NULL)), version = MAX(CASE(service.version IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(TO_STRING(@timestamp), " ", service.version), NULL)), collector = MAX(collector), mapping_events = COUNT(CASE(event.category == "session" AND event.outcome == "success", 1, NULL)), syslog_failures = COUNT(CASE(event.category == "session" AND event.outcome == "failure", 1, NULL)), warnings = COUNT(CASE(log.level IN ("Warning", "Error", "Fatal"), 1, NULL)) BY host.name, service.node.name
| EVAL collector = MV_LAST(SPLIT(collector, " ")), version = MV_LAST(SPLIT(version, " "))
| SORT host.name, service.node.name

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE log.level IN ("Warning", "Error", "Fatal")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, service.node.name, log.level, event.action, user.name, source.ip, error.type, error.code, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 200

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE log.level IN ("Warning", "Error", "Fatal")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, service.node.name, log.level, event.action, user.name, source.ip, error.type, error.code, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 200

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.category == "session"
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, service.node.name, event.action, event.outcome, event.reason, user.domain, user.name, source.ip
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 500

FROM logs-openfsso.receiver-*
| WHERE event.category == "session"
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, service.node.name, event.action, event.outcome, event.reason, user.domain, user.name, source.ip
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 500
